tickerText: [TENNIS] Shanghai Masters Monday: Arthur Gea upset No. 4 Ben Shelton 7-6(5), 7-6(3) in the third round as Zheng Qinwen and Mirra Andreeva withdraw from Wuhan after the China Open final • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Squash Open in Cairo: world No. 1 Mostafa Asal beat Joachim Chuah 3-1 and qualifier Ruqayya Salem stunned ninth seed Tinne Gilis to reach round three • [BADMINTON] VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships open Monday at Cairo International Stadium (Oct 12–17) after China defended the Suhandinata Cup over Malaysia • [PICKLEBALL] Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open week begins—amateur brackets and pro qualifying Monday at Pickleball Virginia Beach with 1,000 ranking points on the line • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash wrapped in Beijing: Wang Manyu retained women's singles gold over Hitomi Sato and Sora Matsushima edged Lin Yun-ju for the men's title

newsItems.title: Gea Upsets Shelton in Shanghai
newsItems.excerpt: France's Arthur Gea took down No. 4 Ben Shelton 7-6(5), 7-6(3) in the Rolex Shanghai Masters third round for his first top-10 win.

newsItems.title: Salem Stuns Gilis in Cairo
newsItems.excerpt: Egyptian qualifier Ruqayya Salem rallied from 9-5 down in the fourth to beat ninth seed Tinne Gilis 3-1 at the CIB Egyptian Squash Open.

newsItems.title: World Juniors Start in Cairo
newsItems.excerpt: The VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships begin Monday at Cairo International Stadium, following China's Suhandinata Cup team title over Malaysia.

newsItems.title: Virginia Beach Open Begins
newsItems.excerpt: The Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open opens with amateur play and pro qualifying Monday at Pickleball Virginia Beach on the 1,000-point PPA slate.
